date.description: The effective calendar date of the transactional, compliance, or operational event entry.

company.description: The legal name of the target portfolio company entity.

type.description: The precise transaction mechanism, tracking event, compliance pivot, or operational update type. Note: a Participating_PricedRound, Participating_SAFERound, or NonParticipating_Round record for a company ASV already holds a position in should be followed by a companion Transaction_ValuationChange record (same date) marking ASV's existing position to the round's new post-money valuation — this applies even when ASV did not participate in the round (NonParticipating_Round), since the round itself is the priced event that sets the new mark. Transaction_ValuationChange is for marks driven by an actual priced transaction; Internal_ValuationAssessment is reserved for a subjective mark with no external pricing event (e.g. a health/market-conditions reassessment).

flagged_date.description: The date the restriction was internally or legally applied.

reason.description: Mandatory audit notes detailing the investment criteria violation.

compliance_status.description: Optional field. Strictly required only when a portfolio asset is flagged as Non-Halal.

compliance_officer_notes.description: Explicit evidence triggering the classification change.

logo_url.description: Company logo image URL — set on the company record, same as sector.

doc_link.description: Optional — omit when the round was reported via plain text/email rather than an actual document.

total_round_size.description: The company's full raise across every investor in this round, not just ASV's own contribution. Optional — omit if not stated in the source document.

driving_event_date.description: The date of the actual priced transaction (e.g. a new financing round — including one ASV did not participate in) that justifies this mark. Use this type, not Internal_ValuationAssessment, whenever an external, arm's-length pricing event set the new value.

asv_total_fair_market_value.description: ASV's existing position re-marked at the transaction's implied valuation (e.g. ASV's ownership percentage times the new post-money valuation).

member_valuations.description: Dictionary mapping each member's 5-digit ID to their share of asv_total_fair_market_value, split in proportion to that member's cumulative cash allocation into this company relative to ASV's total cumulative allocation (the values must sum to asv_total_fair_market_value).

driving_event_date.description: The date of the internal review or subjective reassessment driving this mark — used only when there is no actual priced transaction (see Transaction_ValuationChange for that case, e.g. a new round).

assessment_rationale.description: Why the fund believes this is the fair value absent an external pricing event (e.g. company health/market-conditions analysis).

market_research_grounding.description: Web search insights, M&A/funding comps, and sector trends supporting this risk profile.

valuation_impact_summary.description: Justification for whether this analysis triggers a markup, markdown, or no change.
